issues.legal_issue: Consumer fora may award compensation or punitive damages for loss or injury caused by a service provider’s negligence, but ordinarily may not use compound interest as a measure of punitive damages in a monetary refund case.

The legality and amount of compensation for a builder’s failure to deliver property must be assessed on the facts and circumstances of the case, with the relevant factors and basis of quantification specified.
A builder’s bona fide offer to refund deposited money limits the period for which interest may be imposed on the amount offered, even if the consumer declines the refund.
